name: Selective Gaussian Densification
definition: A densification strategy that classifies Gaussians into 'steady' and 'non-steady' states to determine if densification is needed, replacing the vanilla 3DGS view-space position gradient threshold with a sum-of-norms metric to avoid redundant Gaussians.
summary: Selective Gaussian Densification optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by using a sum-of-norms metric to split only unconverged Gaussians, reducing redundancy and accelerating training compared to vanilla methods.
